mapper.select: SELECT TEAM_NUM, TEAM_NAME, DESCRIPTION, TEAM_PHOTO, TEAM_PHOTO_NAME, COLOR, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, DELETED_AT, CREATOR_NUM FROM TEAM WHERE TEAM_NUM = #{teamNum} AND STATUS != 3

SELECT TEAM_NUM, TEAM_NAME, DESCRIPTION, TEAM_PHOTO, TEAM_PHOTO_NAME, COLOR, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, CREATOR_NUM FROM TEAM WHERE CREATOR_NUM = #{userNum} AND STATUS != 3 ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TEAM SET TEAM_NAME = #{team_name}, DESCRIPTION = #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TEAM_PHOTO = #{team_photo, jdbcType=BLOB}, TEAM_PHOTO_NAME = #{team_photo_name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COLOR = #{color}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE TEAM_NUM = #{team_num}
UPDATE TEAM SET TEAM_NAME = SUBSTR(TEAM_NAME, 1, 20) || '_DEL_' || TEAM_NUM, STATUS = 3, DELETED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE TEAM_NUM = #{teamNum}
mapper.select: SELECT team_num, team_name, description, color, status, creator_num, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM TEAM WHERE team_name = #{teamName}
SELECT TEAM_NAME, COLOR, NVL2(TEAM_PHOTO, 1, 0) AS HAS_PHOTO FROM TEAM WHERE TEAM_NUM = #{teamNum} AND STATUS != 3
